Partner with Harmonex

Harmonex is a modern wellness brand built around purposeful formulas, transparent ingredient amounts and independent testing people can actually see.

Our first two products address two sides of modern wellness:

  • Zeolite Detox — Live Clean: designed to support the body’s natural detoxification and elimination processes.

  • Methylene Blue — Live Sharp: designed to support cellular energy, natural mitochondrial function, mental clarity, focus and alertness.

Why join our affiliate program?

  • Earn 20% commission on qualifying purchases

  • Give your audience 10% off with a personal coupon

  • Benefit from 30-day referral tracking

  • Unlock additional monthly cash performance bonuses

  • Receive automatic PayPal payouts every 15 days once your approved balance reaches $50. We'll send you your balance if it's under $50 and you decide to stop working as an affiliate.

  • Access ready-made product guides, copy starters, visuals and compliance resources

  • Request a complimentary product if you have a relevant, engaged audience or generate your first five approved referral orders

  • Get direct support from the Harmonex team

We are looking for creators, educators, publishers and wellness professionals with audiences interested in clean living, fitness, productivity, cellular wellness, mental performance and thoughtful supplementation.

You bring your voice and audience. We provide the products, resources, guidance and support to help you promote Harmonex confidently and responsibly.

Live cleaner. Think sharper.

Harmonex Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Last updated: August 17, 2026

Welcome to the Harmonex Affiliate Program.

These Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) form an agreement between Harmonex LLC (“Harmonex,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) and each person or entity participating in the Harmonex Affiliate Program (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”).

These Terms govern your application, participation, promotional activities, use of affiliate links or coupon codes, and eligibility to receive commissions.

By applying to or participating in the Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms. If you do not agree to them in full, you may not participate in the Program.

These Terms operate alongside the Harmonex Affiliate Guide, our Privacy Policy, any individual written agreement with you, and the applicable terms of UpPromote or any other platform used to administer the Program. If there is a conflict, these Terms will control unless Harmonex expressly agrees otherwise in writing.

1. Eligibility and application approval

To participate in the Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into this agreement.

  • Provide complete, accurate, and current application information.

  • Identify the websites, social-media profiles, email lists, advertising channels, or other properties you intend to use.

  • Have the necessary rights and permissions to operate those properties and publish promotional content.

  • Comply with all laws, regulations, platform rules, and these Terms.

Harmonex may approve or reject any application at its sole discretion. Submission of an application does not guarantee acceptance, and applicants have no legal claim arising from the rejection of an application.

We may request additional information before approving an application and may withdraw an approval if application information is false, incomplete, misleading, or no longer accurate.

2. General affiliate obligations

As an Affiliate, you agree to:

  • Act honestly, professionally, and in good faith.

  • Promote Harmonex responsibly and without misleading customers.

  • Keep your account information and promotional-channel information current.

  • Comply with applicable advertising, consumer-protection, privacy, email-marketing, intellectual-property, and dietary-supplement laws.

  • Follow the rules of any website, social network, advertising platform, or other channel you use.

  • Pay all taxes, duties, fees, or other obligations arising from commissions paid to you.

  • Cooperate with reasonable compliance inquiries from Harmonex.

  • Correct or remove noncompliant content within 24 hours of receiving a written request from Harmonex.

You may not present yourself as an employee, agent, representative, medical advisor, distributor, or authorized spokesperson of Harmonex.

You must comply with all current Harmonex policies, compliance requirements, claim restrictions, instructions and program rules made available in the Affiliate Dashboard or otherwise provided to you in writing. These materials form part of the Program requirements. In particular, you may use only product claims expressly approved in current Harmonex materials or separately approved by Harmonex in writing.

3. Affiliate links, coupon codes, and attribution

Approved Affiliates will receive a unique affiliate link through the Affiliate Dashboard. You may also be able to generate links for individual products, collections, or approved landing pages.

You may only use affiliate links generated through the Program. You may not manipulate, obscure, redirect, or alter links in a way that hides the original traffic source, interferes with tracking, or misleads customers.

If you are assigned a coupon code:

  • You may promote only the coupon code assigned or expressly approved for you.

  • You may not promote expired, unauthorized, leaked, or customer-service coupon codes.

  • You may not claim that your code provides a discount unless a discount is actually attached to it.

  • A customer’s use of both your affiliate link and your coupon code will not generate two commissions for the same order.

Unless stated otherwise in the Affiliate Dashboard, attribution is determined by the tracking rules and settings used by Harmonex and UpPromote. If a customer clicks more than one affiliate link, the most recent eligible referral may receive attribution.

Only one Affiliate can receive the primary sales commission for an order.

Harmonex’s tracking records will be used to determine attribution, subject to correction in cases of clear technical error.

4. Cookies and tracking limitations

The Program uses cookies and related technologies to track eligible referrals. The applicable tracking period is displayed on the registration page, in the Affiliate Guide, or in your Affiliate Dashboard.

Tracking may not work when a customer:

  • Blocks or disables cookies.

  • Clears their browser data.

  • Uses a different browser or device.

  • Uses privacy or tracking-prevention technology.

  • Completes the purchase outside the applicable tracking period.

  • Uses a link or code that was not assigned or approved through the Program.

Harmonex is not responsible for referrals that cannot be reliably tracked. We are not required to assign commissions manually when the tracking system did not attribute the transaction, although we may do so at our discretion when reliable evidence is available.

5. Qualifying transactions and commissions

Your applicable commission rate is displayed in your Affiliate Dashboard or confirmed in a separate written agreement.

Unless otherwise stated, commissions are calculated on the net product subtotal actually paid by the customer after discounts. Commissions are not calculated on:

  • Taxes.

  • Shipping or delivery charges.

  • Tips or optional contributions.

  • Gift-card purchases.

  • Payment-processing or other fees.

  • Refunded, returned, cancelled, disputed, or charged-back amounts.

A transaction qualifies for commission only if it:

  • Is properly attributed to you through an approved affiliate link or coupon code.

  • Is successfully paid, fulfilled, and not subsequently cancelled, refunded, returned, disputed, or charged back.

  • Results from genuine customer activity.

  • Complies with these Terms and the applicable Program rules.

  • Is not a self-referral or other excluded transaction.

Subscription renewals, recurring orders, wholesale orders, and other special transaction types generate commissions only when expressly stated in the Affiliate Dashboard or a written agreement.

Commission rates, promotional incentives, and performance tiers may differ between Affiliates or change prospectively. Any special rate applies only while confirmed in your Dashboard or written agreement.

6. Review period, reversals, and payments

All referrals and commissions are subject to review before approval. A commission displayed as pending is not yet approved or payable.

Harmonex may reject, reverse, or deduct commissions arising from:

  • Returns, refunds, cancellations, chargebacks, or failed payments.

  • Duplicate or incorrectly recorded transactions.

  • Fraudulent, suspicious, artificial, or incentivized activity.

  • Self-referrals or purchases by the Affiliate for personal use.

  • Orders placed for resale, wholesale, or commercial redistribution without approval.

  • Unauthorized coupon distribution.

  • Violations of these Terms.

  • Technical or administrative errors.

Commissions will be processed according to the approval period, minimum payout threshold, payment method, and payout schedule shown in the Affiliate Guide or Affiliate Dashboard.

You must provide accurate and complete payment and tax information. Missing or incorrect information may delay payment. Harmonex is not responsible for fees, currency-conversion charges, or taxes imposed by payment providers or governmental authorities.

If refunds, chargebacks, or reversals create a negative balance, Harmonex may offset that balance against future commissions.

7. Promotional content and product claims

You may create original content about Harmonex, but all statements must be truthful, accurate, substantiated, and consistent with the product label and Harmonex-approved materials.

When promoting Harmonex products, you must:

  • Use only claims that appear in current Harmonex-approved materials or have been approved by Harmonex in writing.

  • Describe your genuine experience without exaggeration.

  • Use Harmonex products only as directed on the applicable product label.

  • Present required disclaimers clearly and without modification.

  • Correct or remove outdated information, pricing, promotions, or product claims promptly.

  • Obtain all necessary rights for music, photographs, video, graphics, testimonials, or other third-party material used in your content.

You must not:

  • State or imply that a Harmonex product diagnoses, treats, cures, mitigates, or prevents any disease.

  • Describe any Harmonex product as FDA-approved or as a substitute for a drug, medical treatment, or professional healthcare.

  • Make unauthorized claims regarding detoxification, heavy metals, microplastics, cognitive conditions, mental-health conditions, infections, cancer, or any other disease or medical condition.

  • Make structure/function or health-benefit claims unless they are consistent with current Harmonex-approved messaging.

  • Guarantee results or claim that a product will work for everyone.

  • Present personal testimonials as proof of a generally expected result.

  • Use a customer testimonial, review, quotation, image, or video to communicate a claim that you could not legally make directly.

  • Recommend excessive consumption, off-label use, or dosages inconsistent with the product label.

  • Encourage anyone to discontinue medication, ignore medical advice, or replace professional care with a Harmonex product.

  • Promote use by children or show a child consuming a Harmonex product.

  • Misrepresent laboratory testing, certificates of analysis, ingredient quality, manufacturing standards, or scientific research.

If you are a healthcare professional, you must accurately disclose your credentials and remain responsible for complying with all professional, ethical, and legal obligations applicable to you.

8. Affiliate and sponsorship disclosures

Every endorsement must clearly and conspicuously disclose your material relationship with Harmonex.

The disclosure must:

  • Appear close to the endorsement or affiliate link.

  • Be easy for an ordinary customer to notice and understand.

  • Be presented in the same language as the promotional content.

  • Be visible without requiring the customer to click “more,” visit another page, or search through hashtags.

  • Be spoken and displayed visually when the endorsement is made in a video, livestream, or other audiovisual format.

An acceptable disclosure may state:

“I may earn a commission if you purchase through my link.”

If you received a product for free or received any other incentive, that fact must also be disclosed.

A platform’s “paid partnership” tool or a hashtag alone may not be sufficient. You remain responsible for ensuring that every disclosure complies with applicable FTC requirements and other relevant laws.

9. Prohibited promotional activities

Unless Harmonex provides prior written approval, you may not:

  • Purchase paid advertising that directs customers to Harmonex.

  • Bid on “Harmonex,” product names, trademarks, misspellings, or similar branded search terms.

  • Use Harmonex trademarks in domain names, social-media usernames, app names, paid-advertising copy, or display URLs.

  • Place affiliate links or coupon codes on public coupon, deal, cashback, discount-aggregation, or code-sharing websites.

  • Submit an assigned coupon code to browser extensions, toolbars, shopping assistants, or automated coupon services.

  • Use spam, unsolicited commercial messages, misleading email headers, or purchased email lists.

  • Impersonate Harmonex or create the impression that your channel is owned, operated, sponsored, or officially endorsed by Harmonex.

  • Use fake reviews, fake testimonials, fabricated endorsements, bots, click farms, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, hidden links, pop-ups, adware, malware, or other deceptive tracking methods.

  • Offer cashback, rewards, prizes, or other incentives for using your link unless expressly approved.

  • Purchase through your own affiliate link or use your code for your own orders to earn commission.

  • Place bulk orders, resell Harmonex products, or list Harmonex products on Amazon, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop, or another marketplace.

  • Make false or misleading comparisons or disparage competitors.

  • Copy Harmonex’s website or create a confusingly similar website, landing page, social account, or storefront.

All email marketing must be permission-based and comply with the CAN-SPAM Act and any other applicable email or privacy laws.

10. Sensitive and unsuitable traffic sources

Without prior written approval, Harmonex products may not be promoted through:

  • Adult-content websites or sexually explicit platforms.

  • Illegal content, piracy, or unauthorized file-sharing services.

  • Content promoting violence, hate speech, harassment, or discrimination.

  • Gambling or betting platforms.

  • Cryptocurrency, speculative trading, or high-risk investment promotions.

  • Websites or channels primarily directed toward children.

  • Platforms or content promoting illegal drugs, unsafe supplement use, or unlawful activity.

  • Any source that Harmonex reasonably considers harmful to its customers, reputation, regulatory compliance, or brand values.

11. Harmonex intellectual property and marketing materials

Harmonex may provide approved logos, banners, product photographs, copy, links, or other promotional materials through the Affiliate Dashboard.

Harmonex grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable right to use these materials solely to promote Harmonex through the Program.

You may not:

  • Alter Harmonex trademarks or logos without written approval.

  • Remove legal notices, disclaimers, copyright notices, or other required information.

  • Use outdated or withdrawn materials.

  • Sublicense or transfer Harmonex materials to another person.

  • use Harmonex intellectual property after leaving the Program.

All ownership and goodwill associated with Harmonex trademarks, content, and materials remain with Harmonex.

Original content created by you remains yours unless you separately grant Harmonex permission to use it. If you submit content directly to Harmonex for publication or promotional use, the applicable usage rights may be confirmed separately in writing.

12. Monitoring and corrective action

Harmonex may review your public profiles, promotional channels, referral activity, and Harmonex-related content to verify compliance.

At our request, you must provide reasonable information about your traffic sources, advertisements, links, campaigns, or promotional practices.

If Harmonex identifies potentially noncompliant content, we may require you to edit or remove it. You must comply within 24 hours, or sooner when reasonably necessary to prevent customer harm or legal exposure.

Monitoring by Harmonex does not transfer responsibility for your content or conduct to Harmonex.

13. Network and sub-affiliates

If the Network feature is enabled for your account, you may invite others to apply through your approved network link.

Every sub-affiliate must submit a separate application, be approved by Harmonex, and accept these Terms. You may not promise acceptance, specific earnings, commission rates, or benefits on Harmonex’s behalf.

Any network commission is governed by the settings shown in your Affiliate Dashboard. Harmonex may modify, suspend, or deactivate the Network feature at any time.

You may not create deceptive recruitment schemes, charge people to join, or represent the Program as a multi-level marketing business opportunity.

14. Suspension and termination

You may leave the Program at any time by contacting info@liveharmonex.com.

Harmonex may suspend or terminate your participation at any time, including when:

  • You breach these Terms.

  • Your application or account information is false or misleading.

  • Your promotional activity creates regulatory, legal, customer-safety, or reputational risk.

  • You engage in fraud, abuse, manipulation, or suspicious activity.

  • You fail to correct or remove content when requested.

  • Your account remains inactive.

  • Harmonex modifies, suspends, or closes the Program.

Upon termination, you must immediately stop presenting yourself as a Harmonex Affiliate and remove all affiliate links, coupon codes, trademarks, and Harmonex-provided materials.

Valid commissions approved before termination will ordinarily remain payable. However, Harmonex may reject or withhold commissions connected to fraud, invalid transactions, unauthorized promotion, or a breach of these Terms.

No commission will be earned on transactions occurring after termination, even if an old link or coupon code remains technically functional.

You and Harmonex are independent contractors.

Nothing in these Terms creates an employment, agency, partnership, franchise, joint-venture, sales-representative, fiduciary, or exclusive relationship.

You have no authority to make commitments, warranties, representations, or agreements on behalf of Harmonex. You are responsible for your own equipment, business expenses, insurance, licenses, tax reporting, and legal obligations.
